title: Privacy & Data Trust
subtitle: RESOLVE-ONE is local-first. We do not operate tracking trackers, remote customer databases, or telemetry. Your evidence and dispute data remain strictly on your device.
indexedDbDesc: Holds your dispute cases, chronological facts, timeline logs, return records, and actual PDF/image evidence binary files.
localPrefsDesc: Stored in localStorage: dark/light theme, active language, and simple language mode toggle.
cloudDesc: Zero. No personal data, case details, or uploaded receipts are ever transmitted to remote cloud servers.
encryptionDesc: Optionally secure your local storage with an AES-GCM 256-bit encryption key derived via PBKDF2 (100,000 rounds).
passphraseWarning: Because RESOLVE-ONE has zero backend servers or user accounts, if you forget your passphrase, your encrypted dispute records cannot be decrypted or recovered by anyone.
exportDesc: Download a portable, unencrypted JSON backup of all your cases, timeline logs, and evidence records.
deleteDesc: Immediately purges all IndexedDB records, evidence files, purchases, and localStorage settings from this browser.
